newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor head sees positive 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Usinor head sees positive 1996 net profit.

text.p: The chairman of French steel company Usinor-Sacilor said on Thursday he expects 1996 net results to be "significantly positive" despite the weak economic climate and disappointing prices.
"Despite gloomy conditions and disappointing prices, the Usinor-Sacilor group will achieve a significantly positive net result this year," Francis Mer told a steel conference.

"We have shown our ability to cross difficult situations, particularly at the bottom of the cycle," he said. The group posted first half net attributable profit of 833 million francs, versus 2.4 billion a year ago.
At the presentation of its first-half results, the company said it expected second half results lower than the first half but that they would clearly be positive.
